_comment: Happy path against Web Development v1 (node ids 1-5, chain 1->2->3->4->5). React Testing is spliced INTO the chain between Hooks and Router, so the 4->5 edge is removed and replaced by 4->6->5 - the roadmap keeps exactly one starting module. Temp id 6 deliberately collides with a real node 6 in another roadmap, and node 7 depends on node 6, which is also new.
